Decision: Create exactly one independent P013 condition: as-cast Fe50Mn30Co10Cr10 at room temperature, 1e-3 s^-1.
Scientific_Rationale: All time-resolved SXRD points are consecutive observations from one interrupted in-situ tensile condition.
Implementation_Rule: P013_MC_ASCAST_RT is independent; all stages/landmarks are correlated children.

Scientific_Rationale: TRIP is directly quantified by bulk HCP growth; tensile and compression twinning are directly identified by diffraction; dislocation slip is quantified.
Implementation_Rule: Keep phase-specific mechanism scope in provenance.

Decision: Do not count four deformation stages or SXRD loading points as independent samples.
Scientific_Rationale: They belong to the same specimen/test trajectory and are strongly correlated.

Decision: Use initial bulk HCP≈0.33 from transmission SXRD rather than an EBSD-derived phase fraction.
Scientific_Rationale: Authors explicitly warn EBSD/OM polishing can induce surface TRIP and overestimate ε-HCP.
Implementation_Rule: Initial_HCP_fraction_bulk=0.33 with method BULK_SXRD_RIETVELD; EBSD fraction remains unavailable.

Decision: Do not derive exact initial FCC fraction from 1-HCP.
Scientific_Rationale: MnO≈1% is also detected and exact phase-normalization basis is not explicitly established for a simple complement operation.

Decision: Keep engineering YS=319 MPa distinct from ~250 MPa TRIP-onset SXRD landmark.
Scientific_Rationale: 250 MPa is the nearest sampled SXRD point used to define γ-FCC yield/TRIP onset, not the macroscopic engineering YS.
Implementation_Rule: Separate fields for Yield_Strength and Nearest_SXRD_TRIP_Onset_Stress.

Decision: Preserve TWIP as ε-HCP-phase-specific in this paper.
Scientific_Rationale: Authors identify tensile/compression twinning in ε-HCP; γ-FCC twinning is explicitly not a stage-II strain-accommodation mechanism.
Implementation_Rule: Condition TWIP=1, but Mechanism_Phase_Scope must identify ε-HCP.

Decision: Preserve thermal/pre-existing ε-HCP separately from deformation-induced ε-HCP.
Scientific_Rationale: Initial ~33% ε-HCP is described as thermal martensite and can nucleate mechanically induced HCP.
Implementation_Rule: Initial_HCP_fraction is a precursor descriptor; TRIP target is based on its increase during loading.

Decision: Do not infer or import SFE/DeltaG numeric values from references.
Scientific_Rationale: P013 does not numerically report these descriptors in the main paper.
Implementation_Rule: SFE and DeltaG stay NA for P013 unless source-specific supplementary evidence is later supplied.

Decision: Do not digitize every intermediate SXRD point in the current recovery.
Scientific_Rationale: The paper contains a dense time-resolved trajectory; uncontrolled point extraction would inflate correlated observations and add digitization error.
Implementation_Rule: Keep four stage intervals and five high-value landmarks; raw full trajectory can be a separate future longitudinal dataset if justified.

Decision: Treat σ0=179 MPa as secondary-reference model input, not a direct P013 measurement.
Scientific_Rationale: The value is explicitly adopted from Su et al. 2019 for strengthening decomposition.
